+@pytest.fixture()
+def mixed_install_file(tmp_path):
+    requirements_file = str(tmp_path / 'requirements.yml')
+    with open(requirements_file, 'w') as req_obj:
+        req_obj.write('roles:\n- namespace.role\ncollections:\n- namespace.collection\n')
+    return requirements_file
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('command,roles,collections,warning,verbose', [
+    (['install'], True, True, False, False),
+    (['install', '-p', 'custom_roles'], True, False, True, False),
+    (['role', 'install'], True, False, False, True),
+    (['role', 'install', '-p', 'custom_roles'], True, False, False, True),
+    (['collection', 'install'], False, True, False, False),
+])
+def test_mixed_requirements_install(mixed_install_file, capsys, command, roles, collections, warning, verbose):
+    with patch.object(GalaxyCLI, '_install_roles') as install_roles, \
+            patch.object(GalaxyCLI, '_install_collections') as install_collections, \
+            patch.object(ansible.cli.galaxy.display, 'warning') as display_warning, \
+            patch.object(ansible.cli.galaxy.display, 'vvv') as display_vvv:
+        cli = GalaxyCLI(['ansible-galaxy'] + command + ['-r', mixed_install_file])
+        cli.run()
+
+    output = capsys.readouterr().out
+    assert install_roles.called is roles
+    assert install_collections.called is collections
+    assert ('Starting galaxy role install process' in output) is roles
+    assert ('Starting galaxy collection install process' in output) is collections
+    assert ('contains roles which will be ignored' in output) is (command[0] == 'collection')
+    if roles:
+        assert install_roles.call_args[0][0][0].name == 'namespace.role'
+    if collections:
+        assert install_collections.call_args[0][0] == [('namespace.collection', '*', None)]
+    assert any('collections cannot be installed to a roles path' in str(call).lower()
+               for call in display_warning.call_args_list) is warning
+    assert any('contains collections which will be ignored' in str(call)
+               for call in display_vvv.call_args_list) is verbose
+
+

+def test_role_install_processes_transitive_requirements_and_skips_installed():
+    def role(name, dependencies, installed=None):
+        result = MagicMock()
+        result.name = name
+        result.src = name
+        result.scm = None
+        result.version = None
+        result.path = '/tmp/' + name
+        result.install_info = installed
+        result.install.return_value = True
+        result.metadata = {}
+        result.requirements = dependencies
+        return result
+
+    parent = role('namespace.parent', ['namespace.child', 'namespace.installed'])
+    child = role('namespace.child', ['namespace.grandchild'])
+    grandchild = role('namespace.grandchild', [])
+    installed = role('namespace.installed', [], {'version': None})
+    roles = {r.name: r for r in (child, grandchild, installed)}
+
+    with patch.object(GalaxyCLI, '_parse_requirements_file', return_value={'roles': [parent], 'collections': []}), \
